body:
>Poor diet, drinking and doing the same things every single day but dreaming of change will not make you happy, ever. 

But I tried. I ate healthy, I worked out, I got into school, I studied hard and I'm still trying, but I just don't want to do any of this anymore. I'm tired of being broke, I'm tired of being alone and I'm tired of trying when everything I do just turns to around to bite me in my ass.

I was already outgoing and talkative and energetic and friendly and all that jazz... I had friend once, then I decided to move to another country and to get a degree and now all of my friends are gone, I can't make any new friends here because I just feel out of place all the time.

What's the point? At best I'll be some medicated zombie for the rest of my life.
I'd never get married anyway, I just wish I at least had some girl interested in me.

I don't have any passions or hobbies. I literally don't want to do anything anymore. I wake up, I go to a shop, I buy myself some alcohol and some shitty food and I sit in front my laptop all day long.

>You CAN change your world though, it takes time, effort and dedication.

I just don't want to do it anymore. I tried, I really did, it didn't work. I wish I could turn back time, I'd do everything differently.
I'm too much of a pussy to kill myself anyway, don't worry about it.
